model.name: Gemma 3 270M
model.licenseNote: Gemma is provided under and subject to the Gemma Terms of Use found at ai.google.dev/gemma/terms.
model.positions: RoPE after QK-norm; θ = 10,000 in local blocks, 1,000,000 in global blocks
model.mask: local blocks: the last 512 keys, the query itself included; global blocks: causal

examples.title: Boscombe Valley (663 tokens)
examples.prompt: IV. The Boscombe Valley Mystery · first 663 tokens, ending “…, in a very few words. “Bos”

examples.title: Caucus-race (774 tokens)
examples.prompt: III. A Caucus-Race and a Long Tale · first 774 tokens, ending “…best thing to get us dry would be a Caucus”

boscombe.source: Arthur Conan Doyle, The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes (1892), public domain

caucus.source: Lewis Carroll, Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland (1865), public domain

capture.k: after QK-norm and RoPE; the one key head the four query heads share
capture.out: output of o_proj, before post_attention_layernorm and the residual add

extras.rows: [R] position in the passage of each shown query row; tokens are those rows, keyTokens the whole passage
extras.reach: [blocks = 18, H, R] attention each block puts on keys at least 512 behind each shown row (0 in every local block)
extras.layer.*.mask: [R, T] 1 where the shown query may see the key under the mask the model received
extras.layer.*.scores: [H, R, T] q·k / 16 at the shown rows, 0 where masked
